partner_result_applied.applied_scope: Disjoint active spectral supports have density <=2*pi; exact six-variable rotated witness 91/36+(13/6)log2 used as the finite stress baseline.

proved_results.statement: For iid cap-one unit intervals under the normalized 4x4 Hadamard transform, Q=Y1^2+Y2^2-Y3^2 has target spectrum {1,1,-1,0}, while for Z=(X1+X2+X3+X4)/2 and z in [1/2,1], ||p_{Y|Z=z}||_infinity=3/[8(1-z)^3], so no universal pointwise conditional 3D projection-density cap exists.

The six-variable pair-sum source Q=(1/2)S^T(I-2nn^T)S has physical spectrum {1,1,-1,0,0,0} and exact p_Q(0)=4.06307061680603726012548..., exceeding the designated partner finite witness by 0.0334739478... but remaining 0.1795700703... below 3sqrt(2).

replacement_mechanism: Carry unnormalized joint slice mass through rank-three curved integration; do not divide by arbitrarily small conditioning mass. This cancellation is exact on the Hadamard source but no universal raw integrated fiber-sup bound is claimed.
unresolved_implication: Obtain a dimension-free product-preserving rank-three curved-trace/grouped-coordinate inequality that retains unnormalized joint mass, rather than a false pointwise conditional cap or dimension-losing raw fiber supremum.
next_step: Stress two-or-more interacting macroscopic rows plus diffuse residual at off-center levels, and use any resulting witness to constrain the grouped/ridge full-target reduction.
